roadmap.title: Early game
roadmap.description: Finish the tutorial and play normally: sell, craft, quest, hire workers and champions, and expand the shop. Many early counters unlock on their own.

roadmap.title: Mid game
roadmap.description: Raise merchant level, mastery, ascension, enchanting and hero levels while the larger counters build up.

roadmap.title: Long-term grind
roadmap.description: The biggest career totals, rank 11 champions and top item and hero milestones. Nothing here can be lost, so progress only needs time.
